title: Are you free tonight?
instructions: Sophie arkadaşını davet ediyor. Kısa bir diyalog; davetin reddine ve yeni plana dikkat et.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: Dan, are you free tonight? There's a jazz concert in the park.

script.speaker: dan
script.text: I'd love to, but I'm working late tonight.

script.speaker: sophie
script.text: That's a pity. What about tomorrow? We could have lunch.

script.speaker: dan
script.text: Tomorrow's great. Shall we meet at one at the Italian café?
